properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 4 at 3:00PM CST until November 5 at 6:00AM CST by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description: West winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 50 mph.
properties.instruction: Use extra caution when driving, especially if operating a high profile vehicle. Secure outdoor objects.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued November 4 at 10:40PM CST until November 4 at 11:30PM CST by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description: At 1040 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm was located near Oak Park, moving east at 40 mph. HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.
properties.instruction: For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a building.
